To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the human-oriented manufacturing and reindustrialization are two sides of one and the same coin, and that the social factors are the key factors of the reindustrialized countries’ development and prosperity.
the reindustrializaton processes are the main driving forces of development of the human oriented manufacturing systems in all socio-economic systems.

the reindustrializaton processes are to be managed by means of human-oriented manufacturing system design and development, which is based on the social factors’ role increasing in the process of manufacturing systems’ functioning.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: what are the main differences in the design and functioning of human-oriented manufacturing system in the different socio-economic systems, what are the main features of human-oriented manufacturing and reindustrialization in the different countries, what is the role of human-oriented manufacturing in increasing the human capital and social capita in the countries with the different socio-economic system, what are the key factors and instruments for design and development of human-oriented production system in the period of the reindustrializa tion.
a new paradigm of the manufacturing system’s development, that is to be based on the human capital and social capitals’ development.

the following questions: how the human-oriented manufacturing system is designed, what is the role of social capital in its functioning and what is the way of managing these systems in the period of their development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the human-oriented manufacturing and reindustrialization systems in the countries with the different socio-economic systems have the similar goals and tasks, but they have the different methods of achieving them.
the human-oriented manufacturing and reindustrialization systems are the most important and effective tools to overcome the crisis and to develop the society.
the reindustrialisation processes are to be managed with the use of the human-oriented production system’s design and functioning instruments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

in the period when the reindustrializatioin processes are taking place, the human-oriented manufacturing system’s functioning should be based on the principles of the social capital and human capital increasing, the principles of social responsibility and the principles of social partnership.
the human-oriented manufacturing system is an innovative production system that is designed to create a new value and to increase the human capital of the society.
the reindustrialisation process in the countries with the different socio-economic systems is the most important factor of development of human-oriented systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the human-oriented manufacturing and reindustrialization systems should be developed in the way to ensure the increasing of the human capital and social capitals’ level in the countries with the different socio-economic systems.
the human-oriented manufacturing system’s development should be based on the social factors and the system’s social capital should be increased.
the reindustrialized human-oriented manufacturing systems are to be developed as a result of a joint activity of all stakeholders.
